ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (dark grey to black) pixels forming the base substrate, with 15% high-intensity (white to light grey) pixels occurring as localized clusters and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark background with discrete high-contrast white circular ring clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes. High-intensity pixels are concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edge boundary where bio-accumulation is present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 70-80 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks and high-relief variations are visible at the distal tips due to heavy barnacle colonization, creating a non-linear pixel boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the posterior trailing edges, tapering into sharp, upward-pointing convex arcs at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed white circular pixel clusters (ring-shaped) across the surface of both lobes, ranging from 5 to 50 pixels in diameter, most prominent on the left lobe and distal right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear pixel disruptions including a prominent 30-degree arc on the left lobe and multiple short, vertical and diagonal straight-line segments on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral bio-fouling (barnacles) creating significant irregular structural relief along the outer margins and tips of both lobes; extensive scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, high-contrast white 'hook' or 'J' shaped pixel formation located in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.
